title: Qwen Response: 'QwenGo!' Is Not an Independent App, Experience Application Has Been Opened

content_html:
On October 13, the official WeChat account of Qwen released a message stating that the application page for the Personal Agent "QwenGo!" has been launched in the Qwen APP. Users can submit applications through designated entry points within the APP, and Qwen will gradually open up experience qualifications for more users.

The official announcement stated that allowing everyone to have their own personal AI assistant has been Qwen's goal all along. Previously, based on the Alibaba ecosystem and open platform, Qwen has already had personal service capabilities in dozens of fields such as shopping, travel, and logistics.

Qwen launched the Personal Agent "QwenGo!", which is embedded in the Qwen APP, with stronger service capabilities, capable of handling more types and fields of personal tasks.

After experiencing it, reporters found that users can complete tasks such as flight delay compensation, venue and performance reservations, restaurant selection and booking, product price comparison and purchase, and job applications through "QwenGo!". Some users tested and found that QwenGo can help check flight delays and communicate with platform customer service to submit compensation applications. In the test video, the user received a 70-yuan compensation.

The announcement stated that "QwenGo!" will continuously optimize the product experience based on collected usage feedback, to create a smarter and more personalized personal AI assistant.
